description: Use when an agent must see who is accumulating or dumping a Base ERC-20 right now. Input: token address, minutes (1-60, default 60), limit (1-25). Output: JSON top net buyers and sellers (net, received, sent, contract or EOA), largest transfers with tx hash, volume, mints/burns, active wallets, covered window. Busy tokens get a shorter window. Example: ?address=0x4ed4E862860beD51a9570b96d89aF5E1B0Efefed Price: $0.004 USDC via x402.

address.description: ERC-20 token contract on Base mainnet. EOA → 400, non-ERC-20 → 422 (not charged)

minutes.description: Look-back window in minutes (default 60). Very busy tokens are cut short; see window.complete

name: base_token_flows
title: Base token flows: top net buyers and sellers, whale transfers, last 60 min
